items.question: Can Expirely recognize fresh food without expiration dates?
items.answer: Yes! For unpackaged fresh produce like fruits or vegetables, Expirely uses a scientific shelf-life dataset to estimate freshness based on your selected storage location.

items.question: What if the AI misreads a package date?
items.answer: Expirely includes 1-click manual editing for every item. You can quickly adjust product name, expiration date, or storage location at any time.

items.question: Is the app completely free to use?
items.answer: Expirely is free to use. Manual logging and dashboard tracking are unlimited. AI photo scanning and recipe suggestions come with daily free quotas that can be expanded by watching short rewarded ads.

items.question: Is my inventory data secure?
items.answer: All inventory data is securely isolated per user/company account. Photos uploaded are only processed transiently for AI feature extraction.
